title: project.migrate plan
description: The documents the import produced, what the legacy config said ambiguously, and the plan that authorizes writing them.

source.description: The config the import read, pinned. An import is a derivation, and a derivation names what it derived from.

ambiguities.description: Things the legacy config said that the project format has no single place for. First-class rather than diagnostics only: a caller deciding whether to commit an import is deciding about exactly these.
